description: This file defines client-side scripts for the 'Maintenance Schedule' doctype in ERPNext, including form setup, refresh, and custom button logic, as well as a class for handling maintenance schedule actions and interactions.

classes.name: MaintenanceSchedule
classes.description: A class extending frappe.ui.form.Controller to handle maintenance schedule specific logic, including refresh behavior and creating maintenance visits.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles form refresh, adds custom buttons based on document status.

methods.name: start_date
methods.description: Sets the number of visits based on start date.

methods.name: end_date
methods.description: Sets the number of visits based on end date.

methods.name: periodicity
methods.description: Sets the number of visits based on periodicity.

methods.name: set_no_of_visits
methods.description: Calculates and validates the number of visits based on date inputs.
